name: Recreate Destiny service
command:
set -euo pipefail; env_file="${UA_WHATBOX_ENV_FILE:-${XDG_CONFIG_HOME:-$HOME/.config}/upload-assistant/whatbox.env}"; set -a; source "$env_file"; set +a; export SSHPASS="$UA_WHATBOX_PASSWORD"; timeout 150 sshpass -e ssh -4 -o ConnectTimeout=15 -o ServerAliveInterval=5 -o ServerAliveCountMax=2 -o PubkeyAuthentication=no -o PreferredAuthentications=password -o StrictHostKeyChecking=yes artemisprime@destiny.whatbox.ca bash -s <<'REMOTE'
set -euo pipefail
cd ~/Upload-Assistant-wastaken
timeout 30 podman rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
timeout 30 podman pod rm -f upload-assistant-wastaken 2>/dev/null || true
timeout 60 podman compose -f docker-compose.local.yml up -d upload-assistant-wastaken
sleep 25
code=$(curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 http://127.0.0.1:12347/api/health || true)
echo "health_http=$code"
timeout 20 podman ps -a --filter name=upload-assistant-wastaken --format '{{.Names}}\t{{.Status}}'
REMOTE
description: Recreate Destiny’s Upload Assistant after clearing orphaned Podman commands, using port 12347.
